spot_ema_moves_short_horizon.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs

twap_feeds_liquidation_solvency.meaning: the TWAP returned by PanopticPool.getTWAP() is used in liquidation solvency checks (atTicks[1] = twapTick)

twap_feeds_stale_gate.meaning: the TWAP returned by PanopticPool.getTWAP() is used in the StaleOracle gate |currentTick - twapTick| > tickDeltaLiquidation

liquidation_blocked_bad_debt.meaning: liquidations are blocked allowing bad debt to accumulate
liquidation_blocked_bad_debt.checkpoint: after liquidation solvency evaluation using the TWAP

solvent_account_flagged_insolvent.meaning: a borderline solvent account is incorrectly flagged insolvent
solvent_account_flagged_insolvent.checkpoint: after liquidation solvency evaluation using the TWAP

assumptions: The TWAP consumed by liquidation solvency checks and the StaleOracle gate is the value produced by RiskEngine.twapEMA().
Liquidation correctness and liveness are evaluated against the TWAP-derived solvency outcome.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of the intended smoothed TWAP blend or a numeric relation between the TWAP and liquidation outcomes, so the harm to liquidation correctness/liveness is represented only by grounded Boolean outcome observables.
Whether liquidations are actually blocked or solvent accounts are actually misflagged is stated as possible, not observed.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the liquidation_harms impact; TWAP formula mismatch and StaleOracle outcome flips are separate impacts handled in other passes.
The short-horizon spotEMA propagation is conditional in the report and is treated as a scenario precondition.
No concrete TWAP numeric values or tick thresholds are bound; outcome observables are qualitative.
